objectives.description: Reuse a finite set of personal/document fields required by routine forms.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions3.1–3.2 A1/A2;11 service transactions
objectives.rationale: Unresolved P/W field-coverage prerequisite: name, surname, address including street/number/locality/postal code, telephone/contact, birth date/place, nationality, signature and identity/passport/driving document. A1-P and A1-T identity rows retain their meanings; A1-P-283 driving document remains earlier. A2-P owns new personal-data/contact refinements; W owns digital-file fields and document-copy handling. Form values and every possible nationality/address are not additional T words. Exact baseline056–072, including address059/document068/passport069/card070, stay reference identities rather than being reauthored as service-specific duplicates.

objectives.description: Reuse earlier service recognition, staff roles and basic counter objects.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions11.1,11.3–11.7 A1/A2
objectives.rationale: Unresolved A1-T/P/S/W ownership closure: postal letter/stamp/envelope/box and address, bank/cash/card, hospital/pharmacy, school/library, police institution versus officer, firefighters, emergency-help formula and police-station location. Source A2 comisaría/socorro/ambulancia contexts do not silently override A1-T's deliberate early recognition proposals. A2-T police row preserves baseline294 institution; A1-T-085 individual officer is a separate proposed meaning. Baseline300 servicio remains the A1 general service meaning, not newly A2 because a procedure is more complex. W owns educational service11.5 and student/library-card subtypes (A2-W-041/042), while P supplies generic identity/card prerequisites; S owns broader civic institution knowledge.

objectives.description: Reuse the finite earlier mode, ticket, place, room and sign sets.
frameworkSections: 9 specific notions14.1–14.3 A1/A2
objectives.rationale: Unresolved A1-T closure: bus/train/metro/taxi/car/air/boat and ordinary two-wheel modes; station/stop/airport/port/gate/platform; traveller/passenger/driver; ticket/booking/seat/luggage; origin/destination/arrival; hotel/campsite/basic room occupancy and reception; open/closed/entry/exit/no-entry/free-price labels. A1-T-061 physical exit and062 departure remain distinct; current T061 reuses only departure. Entrance versus admission ticket preserves baseline304's ticket identity. A1 accommodation and return-ticket proposals explicitly crosslink their currently A2 stable IDs here. A2 shorter/longer trip, same vehicle in richer narration, or a room amenity does not automatically add a sense.
